# pvecli backup protect

Protect backups: neither pruning nor removal will delete them.

```text
pvecli backup protect VOLIDS [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VOLIDS` | Backup volume(s). |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-n`, `--node VALUE` | Node to go through (default: the node holding the backup). |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
